entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the morning of Livia's trial..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the morning of Livia's trial, and hordes of reporters were gathered in front of the state courthouse. Petr, Lucian and I stood by the entrance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian had helped break the news of..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian had helped break the news of my secretary's arrest. Now the media was beginning to question exactly how a Rumburg agent had been able to infiltrate the Maroon Palace. It was time for me to deliver an explanation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A podium with a bank of microphones..."
entries.dialogueText: A podium with a bank of microphones awaited us on the courthouse steps. Petr looked uncertain. I had told him I would be doing all the talking today.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Remember what we talked about, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember what we talked about, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Koronti's reporters will ask softb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Koronti's reporters will ask softball questions. But I'd still advise you to keep your responses as brief as possible."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You're on your own, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're on your own, Mr. President. I'd advise you to keep your responses as brief as possible."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "How could I forget? I was about to..."
entries.dialogueText: How could I forget? I was about to blame my best friend for a scandal that would otherwise shatter my administration. And Petr still had no idea.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Together, we stepped behind the pod..."
entries.dialogueText: Together, we stepped behind the podium. The reporters clustered around us and started shouting questions.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for coming.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for coming."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for coming."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded. Petr took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded. Petr took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Please settle down.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please settle down."
entries.menuText: "Please settle down."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As you are aware, Livia Suno, form..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you are aware, Livia Suno, former secretary to the President of Sordland, is currently being tried for espionage."
entries.menuText: "As you are aware, Livia Suno, former secretary to the President of Sordland, is currently being tried for espionage."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As you are aware, Ilana Vance, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you are aware, Ilana Vance, the Rumburg spy who posed as my secretary, is currently on trial for espionage."
entries.menuText: "As you are aware, Ilana Vance, the Rumburg spy who posed as my secretary, is currently on trial for espionage."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is unknown exactly how this wom..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is unknown exactly how this woman managed to infiltrate our administration."
entries.menuText: "It is unknown exactly how this woman managed to infiltrate our administration."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Using advanced document forging te..."
entries.dialogueText: "Using advanced document forging technology, this woman managed to pass our rigorous background checks and infiltrate our administration."
entries.menuText: "Using advanced document forging technology, this woman managed to pass our rigorous background checks and infiltrate our administration."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Certain officials failed to conduc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Certain officials failed to conduct the necessary background checks that would have prevented this woman from infiltrating our administration. They are now under investigation."
entries.menuText: "Certain officials failed to conduct the necessary background checks that would have prevented her from infiltrating our administration. They are now under investigation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Please rest assured that the trait..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please rest assured that the traitor will be brought to justice."
entries.menuText: "Please rest assured that the traitor will be brought to justice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Any further covert operations on R..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any further covert operations on Rumburg's part shall be met with our full retaliation."
entries.menuText: "Any further covert operations on Rumburg's part shall be met with our full retaliation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We remain vigilant against externa..."
entries.dialogueText: “We remain vigilant against external and internal enemies. We will not tolerate any crimes against the state.”
entries.menuText: “We remain vigilant against external and internal enemies. We will not tolerate any crimes against the state.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Despite the efforts to undermine t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Despite the efforts to undermine the administration, we are strong, unified and capable as ever.”
entries.menuText: “Despite the efforts to undermine the administration, we are strong, unified and capable as ever.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Both Mr. Vectern and I remain comm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both Mr. Vectern and I remain committed to keeping the great country of Sordland safe and secure."
entries.menuText: "Both Mr. Vectern and I remain committed to keeping the great country of Sordland safe and secure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Many camera flashes went off. A rep..."
entries.dialogueText: Many camera flashes went off. A reporter raised her hand to speak.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes? What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes? What is it?"
entries.menuText: "Yes? What is it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gestured to the reporter."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured to the reporter.
entries.menuText: Let the reporter ask a question.

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. Vectern, I have credible sourc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vectern, I have credible sources saying you personally oversaw Miss Suno's hiring and may have even been carrying on an inappropriate relationship with her--"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President, have you chosen you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, have you chosen your next secretary yet?"
entries.menuText: "Mr. President, have you chosen your next secretary yet? Whoever she is, she's one lucky girl."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put a hand over Petr's mic."
entries.dialogueText: I put a hand over Petr's mic.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Attempts by our enemies to smear M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Attempts by our enemies to smear Mr. Vectern's reputation and further divide the administration. Nothing more."
entries.menuText: "Attempts by our enemies to smear Mr. Vectern's reputation and further divide the administration. Nothing more."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Whoever these 'sources' are, they'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whoever these 'sources' are, they're lying. Mr. Vectern's conduct has been nothing but honorable."
entries.menuText: "Whoever these 'sources' are, they're lying. Mr. Vectern's conduct has been nothing but honorable."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Would you like to submit an applic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you like to submit an application?"
entries.menuText: "Would you like to submit an application?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not yet. But we'll make sure she's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not yet. But we'll make sure she's blonde this time."
entries.menuText: "Not yet. But we'll make sure she's blonde this time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have a few candidates in mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have a few candidates in mind."
entries.menuText: "I have a few candidates in mind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd of reporters all laughed...."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd of reporters all laughed. I sent a silent prayer of thanks to Marcel Koronti.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd of reporters nodded serio..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd of reporters nodded seriously. I sent a silent prayer of thanks to Marcel Koronti.

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Well, whoever she is, she's one lu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, whoever she is, she's one lucky girl."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""My source comes from within the Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "My source comes from within the Maroon Palace itself."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""And are you going to disregard Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "And are you going to disregard Mr. Vectern's established reputation as a serial philanderer?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Men will be men.""
entries.dialogueText: "Men will be men."
entries.menuText: "Men will be men."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lies. All lies.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lies. All lies."
entries.menuText: "Lies. All lies."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I silently gestured to Lucian to en..."
entries.dialogueText: I silently gestured to Lucian to end the press conference.
entries.menuText: Gesture to Lucian to end the press conference.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian interjected."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian interjected.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The President will not be taking a..."
entries.dialogueText: “The President will not be taking any more questions. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He, Petr and I began walking back t..."
entries.dialogueText: He, Petr and I began walking back to the courthouse. Petr and I hung behind to talk.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Evelyn's still divorcing me, that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evelyn's still divorcing me, that can't be helped. But overall, this was nowhere near as bad as it could've been."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A source within the palace? Who do..."
entries.dialogueText: "A source within the palace? Who do you think she meant?"
entries.menuText: "A source within the palace? Who do you think she meant?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You should be thanking your lucky..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should be thanking your lucky stars you're not in that courthouse with her."
entries.menuText: "You should be thanking your lucky stars you're not in that courthouse with her."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have Marcel to thank for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We have Marcel to thank for that."
entries.menuText: "We have Marcel to thank for that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry about Evelyn.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry about Evelyn."
entries.menuText: "Sorry about Evelyn."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I know, I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know, I know."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""She was right. I don't deserve her.""
entries.dialogueText: "She was right. I don't deserve her."
entries.menuText: "She was right. I don't deserve her."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Eh, I'd wager anything she made th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Eh, I'd wager anything she made that up."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""At least everything can go back to..."
entries.dialogueText: "At least everything can go back to normal now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stared at the back of Lucian's he..."
entries.dialogueText: I stared at the back of Lucian's head as he disappeared inside the courthouse.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Normal. We would see about that."
entries.dialogueText: Normal. We would see about that.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That she did can be directly trace..."
entries.dialogueText: "That she did can be directly traced to the carelessness of one man: Petr Vectern."
entries.menuText: "That she did can be directly traced to the carelessness of one man: Petr Vectern."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Therefore, the vice president shal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, the vice president shall be trialled for his shameful actions against the state. If found guilty, he will be imprisoned. Take him."
entries.menuText: "Therefore, the vice president shall be trialled for his shameful actions against the state. If found guilty, he will be imprisoned. Take him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured the traitor shall be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured Rumburg will be made..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured a security breach of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured a security breach of this magnitude shall never happen again."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured a security breach of this magnitude shall never happen again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""However, the fact remains that she..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."
entries.menuText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""However, the fact remains that she..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to access sensitive government information."
entries.menuText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to access sensitive government information."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""She did so by exploiting the weakn..."
entries.dialogueText: "She did so by exploiting the weakness of Vice President Petr Vectern."
entries.menuText: "She did so by exploiting the weakness of Vice President Petr Vectern."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The journalists gasped and murmured..."
entries.dialogueText: The journalists gasped and murmured. Petr turned to face me, his mouth hanging open.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Vectern's willingness to put h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vectern's willingness to put his own infantile desires over Sordland's security has made him a threat to the state."
entries.menuText: "Mr. Vectern's willingness to put his own infantile desires over Sordland's security has made him a threat to the state."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Vectern's recklessness, to say..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vectern's recklessness, to say nothing of his betrayal of Sordish values, has disgraced my administration."
entries.menuText: "Mr. Vectern's recklessness, to say nothing of his betrayal of Sordish values, has disgraced my administration."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Therefore, the vice president has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, the vice president has tendered his resignation. Effective immediately."
entries.menuText: "Therefore, the vice president has tendered his resignation. Effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Wait just a--""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait just a--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put my hand over his mic and gest..."
entries.dialogueText: I put my hand over his mic and gestured to Karl Greiser, who was waiting offstage. He and his men approached Petr.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""How could you do this to me? I kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "How could you do this to me? I know I screwed up, but, Anton -- prison?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Save it for the witness stand.""
entries.dialogueText: "Save it for the witness stand."
entries.menuText: "Save it for the witness stand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry. Lucian made me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. Lucian made me."
entries.menuText: "Sorry. Lucian made me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Stop acting like this whole chain..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop acting like this whole chain of events wasn't your fault."
entries.menuText: "Stop acting like this whole chain of events wasn't your fault."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is for the good of Sordland...."
entries.dialogueText: "This is for the good of Sordland. Trust me."
entries.menuText: "This is for the good of Sordland. Trust me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Karl and his men grabbed Petr's arm..."
entries.dialogueText: Karl and his men grabbed Petr's arms.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Fuck you, Anton! You hear me? Fu--""
entries.dialogueText: "Fuck you, Anton! You hear me? Fu--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The clamor of reporters drowned out..."
entries.dialogueText: The clamor of reporters drowned out his screams as he was led away.

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President!""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The clamor of reporters was growing..."
entries.dialogueText: The clamor of reporters was growing louder. Petr grabbed me by the collar and yanked me away from the microphones.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured the traitor shall be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured the traitor shall be brought to justice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured Rumburg will be made..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured Rumburg will be made to answer for its latest affront to our great country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""However, the fact remains that she..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to access sensitive government information."
entries.menuText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to access sensitive government information."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured a security breach of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured a security breach of this magnitude shall never happen again."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured a security breach of this magnitude shall never happen again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""However, the fact remains that she..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."
entries.menuText: "However, the fact remains that she should never have been allowed to infiltrate our administration in the first place."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That she was able to do so is sole..."
entries.dialogueText: "That she was able to do so is solely due to carelessness on the part of myself and Vice President Petr Vectern."
entries.menuText: "That she was able to do so is solely due to carelessness on the part of myself and Vice President Petr Vectern."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I and Vice President Petr Vectern..."
entries.dialogueText: "I and Vice President Petr Vectern would like to take this opportunity to apologize for our disgraceful lack of oversight."
entries.menuText: "I and Vice President Petr Vectern would like to take this opportunity to apologize for our disgraceful lack of oversight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The journalists gasps and murmured...."
entries.dialogueText: The journalists gasps and murmured. Petr turned to face me, his mouth hanging open.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In his impulsive hiring practices,..."
entries.dialogueText: "In his impulsive hiring practices, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."
entries.menuText: "In his impulsive hiring practices, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In falling victim to seduction, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "In falling victim to seduction, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."
entries.menuText: "In falling victim to seduction, Mr. Vectern displayed a lapse in judgement. But as your president, I bear the brunt of the responsibility."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have failed in my duty to keep t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have failed in my duty to keep this country safe and secure. I hope I can regain your trust."
entries.menuText: "I have failed in my duty to keep this country safe and secure. I hope I can regain your trust."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I failed to notice the enemy that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I failed to notice the enemy that was right under my nose. I hope I can regain your trust."
entries.menuText: "I failed to notice the enemy that was right under my nose. I hope I can regain your trust."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""No! This isn't right!""
entries.dialogueText: "No! This isn't right!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sweat was beading on Petr's brow. H..."
entries.dialogueText: Sweat was beading on Petr's brow. He grabbed the closest microphone.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Please, don't listen to President..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, don't listen to President Rayne. This is all my fault."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I was drunk and reckless. I broke..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was drunk and reckless. I broke my marriage vows. My selfishness compromised the Rayne administration and all of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Tears began streaming down his face..."
entries.dialogueText: Tears began streaming down his face.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I've been a sorry excuse for a hus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been a sorry excuse for a husband and a terrible vice president. I resign."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You don't have to do this.""
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to do this."
entries.menuText: "You don't have to do this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."
entries.menuText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd became even louder. I tur..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd became even louder. I turned away from the microphones and looked at Petr.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, I do. You'd never survive the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I do. You'd never survive the term otherwise. Even with Marcel doing his best."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And I owe you this much, after wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I owe you this much, after what I did."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I owe you this much, after what I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I owe you this much, after what I did."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The reporters were now waving for u..."
entries.dialogueText: The reporters were now waving for us. One woman in the front row looked particularly insistent.

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. Vectern!""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vectern!"
